76: 	 * Extracts nested annotations from an annotation parameter such as {@code onMethod} / {@code onConstructor}
77: 	 * and removes that parameter from the original annotation.
78: 	 */
79: 	public com.sun.tools.javac.util.List<JCAnnotation> unboxAndRemoveAnnotationParameter(JCAnnotation ast, String parameterName, String errorName) {
80: 		ListBuffer<JCExpression> params = new ListBuffer<JCExpression>();
81: 		ListBuffer<JCAnnotation> result = new ListBuffer<JCAnnotation>();
82: 		JavacAST currentAst = this.ast;
83: 		Context astContext = currentAst.getContext();
84: 		JavacTreeMaker treeMaker = currentAst.getTreeMaker();
85: 
86: 		outer:
87: 		for (JCExpression param : ast.args) {
88: 			boolean allowRaw;
89: 			String nameOfParam = "value";
90: 			JCExpression valueOfParam = null;
91: 			if (param instanceof JCAssign) {
92: 				JCAssign assign = (JCAssign) param;
93: 				if (assign.lhs instanceof JCIdent) {
94: 					JCIdent ident = (JCIdent) assign.lhs;
95: 					nameOfParam = ident.name.toString();
96: 				}
97: 				valueOfParam = assign.rhs;
98: 			}
99: 
100: 			/* strip trailing underscores */ {
101: 				int lastIdx;
102: 				for (lastIdx = nameOfParam.length() ; lastIdx > 0; lastIdx--) {
103: 					if (nameOfParam.charAt(lastIdx - 1) != '_') break;
104: 				}
105: 				allowRaw = lastIdx < nameOfParam.length();
106: 				nameOfParam = nameOfParam.substring(0, lastIdx);
107: 			}
108: 
109: 			if (!parameterName.equals(nameOfParam)) {
110: 				params.append(param);
111: 				continue outer;
112: 			}
113: 
114: 			int startPos = param.pos;
115: 			int endPos = getEndPosition(param.pos());
116: 			currentAst.removeFromDeferredDiagnostics(startPos, endPos);
117: 			TreeMaker.instance(astContext).at(startPos);
118: 
119: 			if (valueOfParam instanceof JCAnnotation) {
120: 				String dummyAnnotationName = ((JCAnnotation) valueOfParam).annotationType.toString();
121: 				dummyAnnotationName = dummyAnnotationName.replace("_", "").replace("$", "").replace("x", "").replace("X", "");
122: 				if (dummyAnnotationName.length() > 0) {
123: 					if (allowRaw) {
124: 						result.append((JCAnnotation) valueOfParam);
125: 					} else {
126: 						addOnXError(errorName);
127: 						continue outer;
128: 					}
129: 				} else {
130: 					for (JCExpression expr : ((JCAnnotation) valueOfParam).args) {
131: 						if (expr instanceof JCAssign && ((JCAssign) expr).lhs instanceof JCIdent) {
132: 							JCIdent id = (JCIdent) ((JCAssign) expr).lhs;
133: 							if ("value".equals(id.name.toString())) {
134: 								expr = ((JCAssign) expr).rhs;
135: 							} else {
136: 								addOnXError(errorName);
137: 							}
138: 						}
139: 
140: 						if (expr instanceof JCAnnotation) {
141: 							result.append((JCAnnotation) expr);
142: 						} else if (expr instanceof JCNewArray) {
143: 							for (JCExpression expr2 : ((JCNewArray) expr).elems) {
144: 								if (expr2 instanceof JCAnnotation) {
145: 									result.append((JCAnnotation) expr2);
146: 								} else {
147: 									addOnXError(errorName);
148: 									continue outer;
149: 								}
150: 							}
151: 						} else {
152: 							addOnXError(errorName);
153: 							continue outer;
154: 						}
155: 					}
156: 				}
157: 			} else if (valueOfParam instanceof JCNewArray) {
158: 				JCNewArray arr = (JCNewArray) valueOfParam;
159: 				if (arr.elems.isEmpty()) {
160: 					// Just remove it, this is always fine.
161: 				} else if (allowRaw) {
162: 					for (JCExpression jce : arr.elems) {
163: 						if (jce instanceof JCAnnotation) result.append((JCAnnotation) jce);
164: 						else addOnXError(errorName);
165: 					}
166: 				} else {
167: 					addOnXError(errorName);
168: 				}
169: 			} else {
170: 				addOnXError(errorName);
171: 			}
172: 		}
173: 		for (JCAnnotation annotation : result) {
174: 			if (annotation.type != null) annotation.type = null;
175: 			if (JavacHandlerUtil.JCAnnotationReflect.getAttribute(annotation) != null) {
176: 				JavacHandlerUtil.JCAnnotationReflect.setAttribute(annotation, null);
177: 			}
178: 			clearTypes(annotation);
179: 		}
180: 		ast.args = params.toList();
181: 		treeMaker.at(-1);
182: 		return result.toList();
183: 	}

264: 			break;

266: 			visitor.visitMethod(this, (JCMethodDecl) get());
267: 			ast.traverseChildren(visitor, this);
268: 			visitor.endVisitMethod(this, (JCMethodDecl) get());
269: 			break;
270: 		case INITIALIZER:
271: 			visitor.visitInitializer(this, (JCBlock) get());
272: 			ast.traverseChildren(visitor, this);
273: 			visitor.endVisitInitializer(this, (JCBlock) get());
274: 			break;
